source_interpretation: HRegionServer.blockAndCheckIfStopped calls blockUntilAvailable(msgInterval, false). With refresh=false, ZKNodeTracker.blockUntilAvailable skips its conditional ZooKeeper reads and waits on the tracker monitor.

The nodeCreated getDataAndWatch fault door was observed only after the two selected rs0 check events; those callback doors had unknown node identity. The healthy trace did not establish a same-tracker callback-to-waiter edge.

A KeeperException caught in ZKNodeTracker.nodeCreated calls abortable.abort; HRegionServer.abort stops the server. The selected IOException is the explicit response to stopped being true, so observing that exception alone would not establish a product bug.
TestClusterBootOrder.testBootRegionServerFirst does not assert post-abort service recovery. Its waitForServerOnline can return when the server is stopped.
decision: healthy_no_injectable_door; no fault trial or completed campaign. Do not infer that the monitor transformer failed to load solely from absent monitor transfer events. A further run would need a named, target-retaining pretarget door and a same-tracker monitor handoff to support this check.
